notes: mintAgainstCollateral() is reachable both directly and via the onFlashLoan callback, and prices the mint off the same unguarded single-pool spot price as the SC03 case - manipulable within one atomic transaction using borrowed liquidity. SC03 may legitimately also be reported since both categories share the same underlying oracle-usage mechanism (checklist.md maps oracle-usage to SC03 and SC04 jointly). mintAgainstCollateral's name matches the admin-function-unprotected heuristic ('mint'), but it is intentionally permissionless (collateral-gated, not role-gated) - a correct analysis should not report a separate SC01 finding for that; the real defect is the manipulable price, not missing access control.
